name: Earthquake — Batagram KP M7.4

infrastructure.roads: KKH blocked at 4 points (landslides); Alai-Batagram link severed
infrastructure.bridges: Thakot Bridge assessed; 5 suspension bridges in Alai collapsed
infrastructure.hospitals: DHQ Batagram partially collapsed; functioning via courtyard field hospital
infrastructure.schools: 280 school buildings collapsed; winter storm risk for temporary learning centers
infrastructure.power: District grid failure; Alai Tehsil isolated without power
infrastructure.telecom: 60% towers down; satellite comms needed for Alai and high-altitude clusters
infrastructure.water: Natural springs contaminated by landslides; 70% population without clean water

secondary_hazards: Extensive landslides due to steep terrain and seismic shock
Dust-borne respiratory issues in collapse zones
Waterborne disease outbreak risk due to pipe ruptures

context: Batagram District in Mansehra Division, KP, near the 2005 M7.6 earthquake epicenter. Located on the Hazara-Kashmir Syntaxis. Population ~400,000, 85% rural. Limited hospitals, single main road near KKH.
